services.desc: Our half day near shore charters out of Va Beach include trolling the beach for tasty Spanish mackerel and bluefish. They are a perfect way to introduce inexperienced anglers both young and old alike to a coastal charter fishing experience with lots of action. Your fishing results and an awesome experience are almost guaranteed and your comfort will never be at question on our Four Reel Sportfishing half day near shore charter fishing excursion.
